title: Path of adventure
description: this project adds more achievements related to biomes.
body:
The project adds 57 achievements. 1 initial, 4 challenges, 2 regular, and 50 achievements related to biomes. The project includes features for earning achievements. Users can download this mod to set new challenges for themselves. The goal of this mod is to provide players with new content related to achievements. .Please note that the mod may contain errors.

achievement names:

initial:
Start the story
challenges:
Impossible
Create a star
Millionaire
Miliorder (in Russian but in English)
regular:
it black
it light
achievements related to biomes: almost all biomes
